subject: Re: HSPACE kickoff - staffing and render compute
body:
Lucia,

Staffing plan for the window:

- Freya 50% throughout (GHUM fitting quality, motion retargeting evaluation).
- Milan 70% (scene placement, engine export).
- Farah Haddad is committed at 60%+ to HSPACE for June 2026 - she owns the render-farm orchestration for the May campaign and then drives dataset packaging and the v1 freeze through early June. I have her calendar blocked for it.

Compute: the render campaign is CPU/GPU-mixed; we've sized it at ~40 titan-a100 GPUs best-effort for four weeks in May. No Vulcan reservation - renders tolerate preemption fine. Storage is the bigger ask: ~180 TB for the million-frame v1, which I've filed with the platform team.

One dependency: the parametric shape-variation sweep (the piece that takes us from 100 scans to 1,600 humans) needs Freya's fitting QA done first, so that's the critical path item for March.

Alina
